comment: cmd.c parseautocomplete() reports the unknown extended command with raw_printf() and waits, and raw_printf() counts it in ge.early_raw_messages (pline.c:557, :580). On the restore, sys/unix/unixmain.c main() (255-262) therefore writes 'Restoring save file...' with raw_print(), so it stays below the configuration error rather than on the top line, and restore.c dorecover() (933-940) waits once more before docrt() erases the screen. raw_print() files nothing in the message history, so ^P after the restore recalls the welcome back and then the first segment's messages, with no 'Restoring save file...' among them.
